body:
As of late, I have been having major issues with my girlfriend. We have been running a business and have had financial issues, her parents don't want us together, and her love has slowly been waning for me over the last few days.  Prior to deciding to dose Xanax, I was feeling extreme anxiety. Sleep deprivation, not eating, stress, depression, all that. I found myself in a very hard spot. Last night I took 2mg, and I garnered the strength to talk to my girlfriend
T:0:15 mild effects in thoughts
T:1:00 Chest pressure has eased, anxiety has relaxed, I am able to think somewhat clearly and consciously. Before I had been a wild mess.
T:1:15 Me and the girlfriend finally have a deep conversation, she's been kicked out of her house for being with me so she is with me currently. She confesses her love and I tell her deep things I would have not been able to otherwise without the weight off my chest from the anxiety.
She confesses her love and I tell her deep things I would have not been able to otherwise without the weight off my chest from the anxiety.
Regardless, it seemed to be helping at this point.
T:1:30 I feel as I'm peaking, I'm very happy and hopeful for us. I talk to her very excitedly, and it leads to some intimacy. No issues noticed there, great in depth passion.
This is where I start to forget things. My head is relaxed and I'm back to a roller coaster crying as I garner the strength to confront the problems I face. After we make love, I leave to go outside and sit. I come back to sit down with her and we lay and I forget the rest of the night away.
The day after, I woke up and immediately took another 2mg bar. Tried to nap, I have been sleep deprived for weeks. Lost it because of another stressful event presenting itself. The Xanax seemed to have helped less today than it did yesterday.
Xanax will help your anxiety. IT wont fix your problems.
